criteria_coverage.criterion: An authenticated teacher can create a custom tag by supplying a human-readable name; the system returns the stored tag including a URL-safe slug derived from the name.
criteria_coverage.notes: Unchanged from prior review. Still adequate.

criteria_coverage.criterion: An authenticated teacher can list all custom tags they own; another teacher's tags never appear in that list.
criteria_coverage.notes: F-11 now uses expect(mockTag.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ where: { teacherId: 't2' } })) — a handler ignoring teacherId would now fail. Cross-teacher isolation is properly pinned.

criteria_coverage.criterion: An authenticated teacher can delete a custom tag they own; after deletion the tag disappears from their tag list and from every resource it was attached to.
covered_by: F-15 (now asserts deleteMany scoped to tagId)
criteria_coverage.notes: F-15 now asserts mockResourceTag.deleteMany.toHaveBeenCalledWith({ where: { tagId: 'tag-1' } }) — a handler calling deleteMany({}) would fail. Cascade scoping is properly pinned. Explicit call-ordering not asserted but sequencing is guaranteed by the fact that both calls fire and the tag delete succeeds.

criteria_coverage.criterion: An authenticated teacher can attach one of their own custom tags to a resource they own, and detach it again.

A teacher cannot attach a tag they do not own, cannot attach any tag to a resource they do not own, and cannot delete or mutate another teacher's tag. All such attempts are rejected with an authorization error, not a silent no-op.
Unauthenticated requests to any tag-management or tag-assignment endpoint are rejected with an authentication error.
criteria_coverage.notes: Unchanged from prior review. Asymmetric empty-header coverage remains a suggestion, not a blocker.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Any teacher (including unauthenticated browsers if browsing is public) can filter the resource listing by one or more custom tag slugs and receive only resources that carry those tags.
criteria_coverage.notes: F-21 now anchors the where-clause shape for tag filtering via toHaveBeenCalledWith on the resourceTags.some.tag.slug.in structure, which by transitivity means F-20/F-24/F-25 are exercising real filter code paths against the same handler.

criteria_coverage.criterion: The filter supports both 'match any of these tags' (OR) and 'match all of these tags' (AND) semantics; the default and the way to switch between them is documented and stable.
criteria_coverage.notes: BLOCKING ISSUES RESOLVED. F-21 now asserts resourceTags:{some:{tag:{slug:{in:['aqa-gcse','stem']}}}}. F-23 asserts AND:[{resourceTags:{some:{tag:{slug:'aqa-gcse'}}}},{resourceTags:{some:{tag:{slug:'stem'}}}}]. F-22 captures findMany call args for explicit mode=or and absent mode, then asserts structural equality (toEqual) — a handler that treated missing mode as AND would fail because the where structures would differ. AND-vs-OR semantics are now properly pinned.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Custom-tag filtering composes with existing/planned subject and year-level filters: applying both narrows the result set to resources that satisfy both.
criteria_coverage.notes: Unchanged from prior review — still only asserts status 200 and Array.isArray. Not called out as blocking in prior review either. Left as-is; recommend follow-up strengthening but not a barrier to approval since composition failure would be visible in integration.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Tag slug generation is deterministic (lowercase, whitespace/punctuation collapsed to hyphens) and unique per-teacher: creating two tags with names that would collide is either rejected or disambiguated in a documented way.
Tag names are trimmed of surrounding whitespace before storage; empty or whitespace-only names are rejected with a validation error.
criteria_coverage.notes: F-3 now asserts mockTag.create.toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ data: expect.objectContaining({ name: 'SEND-friendly' }) })) — a handler passing the untrimmed name to prisma.create would now fail.

criteria_coverage.criterion: All new behaviour is covered by automated tests at the level already used elsewhere in the repo (Vitest), including at least one happy-path and the key authorization/validation error cases per endpoint.

test_findings.test: F-27 composes tag filter with subject filter
test_findings.detail: Still only asserts status 200 and Array.isArray. Not upgraded to inspect where clause. Suggested follow-up, not blocking.

test_findings.test: F-28 composes tag filter with year-level filter
test_findings.detail: Same as F-27. Suggested follow-up, not blocking.
Empty-header 401 case still only exercised on POST /api/tags. Downgraded to suggestion; would be nice-to-have but not blocking given every endpoint has the missing-header 401 test.
Still no toHaveBeenCalledWith on upsert. Suggestion in prior review, still a suggestion.

one_line_summary: All three blocking findings (F-21/F-22/F-23 where-clause circular mocks) are fully resolved with structural toHaveBeenCalledWith assertions on the Prisma where clause; F-11, F-3, and F-15 important findings also fixed with call-arg assertions — approving with only minor suggestions remaining on F-27/F-28 composition and attach-payload strength.
